assertions.assertion: Adds Duende.Storage.Sqlite (and Duende.IdentityServer) packages with --prerelease and notes Duende Storage is a preview
assertions.rationale: Packages added with --prerelease and states preview.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(...)) with a connection string on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(options => options.ConnectionString=...)) chained on AddIdentityServer.

assertions.assertion: Calls both AddConfigurationStorage() and AddOperationalStorage() (AddStorage alone does not store IdentityServer data)
assertions.rationale: Chains both AddConfigurationStorage() and AddOperationalStorage() and warns AddStorage alone stores nothing.

assertions.assertion: Runs IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync (development) and does not hide a missing connection string
assertions.rationale: Calls IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync in Development and throws InvalidOperationException on missing connection string.

assertions.assertion: Notes AddServerSideSessions() must still be called separately to use server-side sessions
assertions.rationale: Chains AddServerSideSessions() with comment that it is needed to enable server-side sessions.
